instructions: Run only against explicitly approved isolated loopback engines with --approved-local-services. Each provider fixture needs oracle.reviewed=true, source_sha256, engine_version, graph_revision, profile. Record actual installed metadata and compare graph/profile scope before interpreting results. Generic HTTP errors are not no-route evidence. All alternatives and ordered required_waypoints are checked. Never target production or use provider option acceptance as proof.
